reading.title: Math Words in a Muffin Shop
reading.purpose: Learn math words by watching a baker count muffins.
paras: A baker uses math words. She may estimate how many muffins fit in a box. The total is all the muffins added together.
Five friends each take one of ten muffins, so five remain. That is half of ten. The difference between 10 and 5 is 5. Double 5 is 10, so a baker counts twice to check.

qs.q: Five muffins remain. What does remain mean?
choices: To be left after some are taken.
qs.why: Five friends took muffins, and five were left over.

qs.q: Five friends each take one of ten muffins. How many muffins remain?
qs.why: The reading says now five remain.
Double means two times as much, and two times 5 is 10.
